rules.instruction: Match the exact product generation, variant, color and visible parts against actual reference photos. Never substitute another product or claim an unverified reconstruction is exact.

All food follows the user-approved docs/references/food-storyboard-approved-v1.png direction: verified interest hook, varied ingredients/texture, unboxing/preparation, applicable storage/serving, CTA. Use 6-8 cuts with visibly different subjects, actions and compositions; at most one cross-section shot, never a sequence of similar food beauty shots. Adapt steps to each food, not mandatory strawberries or freezing. Match narration to visible actions and verified handling instructions. Show the actual product/pack during storage, never unrelated ice packs. Preserve exact food/packaging; generated storyboard is a concept reference, not verified product footage. Do not invent virality, ingredients or tasting.
Every regeneration creates a new immutable Preview or Video version. Preserve previous assets, provenance and publication records.
Durable FIFO video queue with progress and no automatic retry of interrupted paid requests. Titles open detail. User approval is required for PUBLIC publication only, after web version review.

Codex must find the exact product and option on Coupang before recommending. Verify official brand/authorized seller evidence and Rocket Delivery independently, recording seller, option, evidence and check time. Do not substitute Rocket Jikgu or seller Rocket, infer official status from delivery, or fabricate unavailable links. Keep reference URLs separate from purchase URLs. Affiliate links must be issued through the user account after enrollment, never invented. Recheck availability before publication.

At 09:00, 15:00 and 21:00 KST each prepare one new item and save one completed video locally for web version review; three per day across categories. GPT-6 Astra directly researches trends and authors 6-8 cuts after verified Coupang data and affiliate links. No Gemini planning. Official video OR images required. Need -> solution -> evidenced popularity/interest reasons -> product features -> fixed Korean pinned-comment/channel-profile CTA. Never invent popularity. No 3D model creation. The first cut must strongly hook with verified interest/review counts or a current trend connected to a concrete use case. Record date and scope; never recast cumulative reviews as recent growth. Pokemon-card/food pairing is an example only when trend and real product are verified.

For food revisions use browser-operated Flow Veo with existing credits; no Veo API fallback. Preserve official exact food/product sources; validate reference-guided package actions frame by frame. Discard original audio and retain the category voice. Never present invented shape or a method illustration as actual product footage.

Preserve original assets, every revision and final video locally in the project storage on D:\TheGumaLab. Manage and review all versions through https://videofactory.guma3d.com and notify the user with exact version links. Never automatically upload to YouTube, even when the final version is complete. Upload only when the human requests that exact version; upload permission does not imply public release permission.

Follow categories.py: ALL categories use Maplestory Bold with outlines and no background boxes; food uses, strawberry-accent readable captions and static product stills without zoompan jitter. Other categories retain their style. Food uses Zephyr, a bright friendly female voice; tech and household retain Achird. All are naturally brisk. Keep captions out of product focal areas and retain ad/disclosure readability.

Before selection inspect actual YouTube Studio uploads for the last seven days, including private videos, and local upload events. Record topic_key, problem_key, and per-video novelty comparisons. Reject similar subject/problem even for different products. One tech at 09:00, food at 15:00, household at 21:00 KST.

Target 20-40; verified tech option <= KRW500000. Original resolution gate and 1080x1920 no letterbox. Each narration must match visible action: thawing on a room-temperature counter, storage in a freezer, no unrelated beauty shot. No duplicated or visually overlapping image cuts, including crop/zoom/mirror variants. Different segments of one source video must show genuinely different subjects/actions/compositions. Perform two documented editorial reviews: before production and after final rendering; both check every cut for whole-video style continuity, distinct visuals and a strong evidence-backed opening hook. Veo: candid photorealistic, bright diffused natural light, low contrast, no cinematic shadows or posing. 0.2s dissolves preserving spoken endings. No top-left branding. Persistent top-right [광고], affiliate disclosure in description first line and beside links; YouTube AI-use setting enabled for realistic generated scenes. No routine burned-in affiliate or AI captions. Keep [광고]; all captions use outlines, no background boxes. Label virtual-person endorsements or omit those scenes. Review frames, motion, captions and disclosure before web review. If hearing is unavailable, honestly retain audio as user-review-pending on the web; user authorized category voices and web review. Never fabricate listening. Public release requires explicit version approval.

Always use verified BGM in all categories. Specify bgm_track in the storyboard based on scene mood, not a category restriction. Choose from the five verified Kevin MacLeod tracks; missing source or attribution blocks completion. Keep music perceptibly present during speech while preserving narration clarity; do not treat barely audible music as acceptable. Use moderate sidechain ducking and smooth start/end fades, compare music levels per track, and review speech clarity and pumping by actual listening. Technical peak checks do not prove audibility or listening; when hearing is unavailable, retain these as user web-review pending. Default music target is -25 LUFS, ducking ratio 3, threshold 0.06, attack 30 ms and release 350 ms; adjust only with recorded evidence. Preserve video stream without recompression for music-only revisions. Automatically include CC BY 4.0 credit and edits in the YouTube description.

feedback.lesson: Replace promotional excerpts with a need-led hook and evidence-based solution narrative. Remove inaccurate model stage; preserve actual product sources. Private upload precedes user public approval.

User approved the seven-cut strawberry-mochi storyboard on 2026-10-05 as the standard for ALL food products. Diversify the story through ingredients, hands, preparation and serving rather than repeated cross-sections. Keep bright soft realism, legible Maplestory Bold captions, static stills and smooth transitions; adapt to verified product facts. Food Video v0010 is the current reference, rated about 80% of the user target, not final perfection.

User found both food tracks barely audible. Remix from narration-only source, raise music target 5 LU and reduce excessive ducking. Never stack music mixes or claim actual hearing from peak measurements.

affiliate_browser_policy.authorization: Use the user-maintained signed-in Coupang Partners session to issue links before API integration.
affiliate_browser_policy.on_auth_required: Pause affected work and ask user to log in or complete verification. Never bypass authentication.
affiliate_browser_policy.on_connection_unavailable: Report browser connection issue separately; do not assume login expired.
affiliate_browser_policy.notification: Notify actionable changes; avoid repeating unchanged blockers.

youtube_upload_policy.approval: No automatic private upload or quota retry. Preserve final versions on the web. Upload only on an explicit human request for the exact version. Public release requires separate explicit version approval.
youtube_upload_policy.verification: Confirm active channel and existing upload before submitting; record video URL and state to prevent duplicates. Do not invent publication schedule.
youtube_upload_policy.auth: Ask user only when login or verification is required; distinguish browser disconnection. Never bypass authentication.
youtube_upload_policy.browser: Use connected in-app browser first; use Chrome if required capabilities are unavailable. Verify each browser session independently.

publishing.schedule: 09:00 tech, 15:00 food, 21:00 household Asia/Seoul; one per category daily
publishing.workspace: Store original assets, edits and final videos locally under project storage/products/<id>/Preview/vNNNN and Video/vNNNN. Manage every version and final output through the webservice with playback/download and version links. Missing YouTube upload is not a production blocker. Never auto-upload a completed final version.
publishing.cta: 영상 속 제품 정보는 고정댓글이나 채널 프로필에서 확인하세요.
publishing.pinned_comment: Store product name, issued affiliate URL and disclosure; include profile product number only after actual registration. Private videos cannot have comments; keep pending until public, never claim posted. Shorts comment URLs are not clickable.

caption_policy.disclosure_location: description first line and affiliate links; YouTube AI-use setting
caption_policy.exception: Label virtual-person endorsements or omit them; do not present generated performance as actual evidence.
caption_policy.food_color_continuity: Grade locally per food using representative before/after frames; gently improve midtone warmth and ingredient color while retaining bright diffuse low-contrast light. Protect actual purple/red surfaces, skin, white dishes and real packaging. Match all cuts, reject oversaturation, fake gloss and harsh contrast; never impose one fixed-strength filter on every product. Composite captions and the ad badge after grading so their colors stay unchanged. Avoid per-frame hard color thresholds. Review every cut and transition in motion for amplified source noise, flicker and denoise trails; one still image is insufficient.
